unit: MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab (MIT-IBM Computing Research Lab)

labs.pi_title: MIT Director, MIT-IBM Computing Research Lab; Senior Research Scientist, MIT CSAIL
labs.research_summary: A joint MIT-IBM research collaboration developing foundational AI, algorithms and quantum computing; co-directed with David Cox of IBM Research and co-chaired by MIT Provost Anantha Chandrakasan, IBM's Jay Gambetta and MIT Schwarzman College of Computing Dean Dan Huttenlocher.
labs.member_breakdown: Leadership: MIT co-chair Anantha Chandrakasan, IBM co-chair Jay Gambetta, MIT co-chair Dan Huttenlocher, MIT co-director Aude Oliva, IBM co-director David Cox, plus named AI/algorithms/quantum leads from both MIT and IBM. The lab's directory lists roughly 300 affiliated MIT faculty/researchers and IBM researchers alphabetically with no role breakdown, so an exact current-member count wasn't extracted this pass.
labs.notes: A joint MIT-IBM lab, not a single-PI group; recorded the MIT co-director as the primary contact. Most listed MIT-side researchers (e.g. Jacob Andreas, Dimitris Bertsimas, Isaac Chuang, Marzyeh Ghassemi) have their own primary labs recorded in their home departments (EECS, Sloan, Physics) -- not duplicated here. IBM-side researchers are not MIT-affiliated and aren't tracked elsewhere in this project. Member count intentionally left null given the directory's size and lack of role/affiliation breakdown in this pass.
